title: Mixed Event — Rise as One! — Episode3 Behind His Refusal

meta.Event Outline: On one of his daily runs, Akito has an encounter with a dog and his owner. The pair has been training day by day in the hopes of one day winning a national disc dog competition. But the day before their next competition, this dog owner sprains his ankle...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Haha. Pretty stupid of me, right...?
But I can still throw since it's just a light sprain.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, you've gotta be careful. It's going to take a lot longer to heal if you don't rest properly...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Thanks, I know.
But I'm okay, honest! Just watch! Catch...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He says he's fine, but he's not moving like he's fine...)

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Huh? Why aren't you running? I said, “Go!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Max decided to sit down...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
What's wrong, Max?
The competition's tomorrow, remember...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What if Max knows that you're hurt...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think he's staying put because he doesn't want you to keep throwing that disc...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, so...
He doesn't want to fetch the disc because he doesn't want to force his partner to keep throwing it?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Which means Max is going out of his way to disobey Ishihara because he's worried about his partner's ankle...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (On the other hand, are dogs even capable of that sort of thought...?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, he's rubbing his head against your ankle...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I know this isn't really any of my business, but I don't think you should push yourself any further...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I feel that Max would be so sad if anything were to happen to you...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Thanks for showing so much concern for me, Max. I'll take it easy tomorrow to let my ankle heal instead of participating in the competition...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: We've been practicing so hard for tomorrow, but can't participate now because of a mistake I made...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(I get how he feels...
I'd be frustrated too after practicing every day like they have.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Even more so if it also makes your partner's efforts go to waste...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, would it be possible for Max and I to enter into that competition...?!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Well, you can technically register the day of, so I don't see why not...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, if it's okay with you, Ishihara, I'll compete in your place!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Yes, Max would still get to compete...
But are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! Please let me do this!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want to show my support for Max since he's been working so hard towards your guys' dream!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Thank you for your kind offer, Hanasato...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Max and I need to build up a good record together in order to compete on the national stage...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
But I don't want his efforts to go to waste.
I want him to compete and do his best.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Of course! You can count on me...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, lemme give this a try!
Ready, Max?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa, that's got some pepper to it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Nooo!
Why'd it go that way?!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Uhh... It sliced a little, but you definitely get full marks for power!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A little? It flew completely sideways.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, is Max looking for the disc?
It went that way! Over there!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I'm sorry. I didn't think it'd be this hard.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Th-That's okay!
It also took me a long time to get the hang of throwing one of these!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Plus, you have to practice a lot to get it to fly where you want. Now I feel like I'm asking too much of you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh... But if I keep practicing more and more...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: No. I really appreciate the thought, but I can't force you to do all that just for us...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: As terrible as I feel about Max, we're just going to have to give up on tomorrow's competition.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wait, Shinonome...
Doesn't this mean Max wants you to take the disc...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, look!
He's pawing at it like he wants you to throw it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hang on...
Does this mean he wants to enter into that competition with you?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, don't put words in his mouth. I mean, you don't seriously believe...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Actually, I think she may be right...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Um, it's just...
Max has such a serious expression on his face right now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: He may've noticed how frustrated Ishihara is over not being able to participate in that competition, and decided that he wants to enter...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Yeah, it does look like he's trying to tell us something...)

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Oh, I think I know why...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: He must've remembered how well you threw his disc the other day.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Wait, the disc...!
If I throw it somewhere far in that direction...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I'll enter into that competition with Max...
Based on what I did last time, I think I have a good idea of how to throw one of these.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: But... Shinonome, I thought you didn't like...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I don't know how things are going to turn out...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let's just say I understand how you feel when it comes to not wanting to let your partner down.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Then, if you're really sure...!
I promise to give you guys all the support I can.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In that case, may I help out as well...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I may be able to give you some assistance since I'm used to taking care of dogs.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Shibao and Samo said they also want to help!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
That'd be great...!
I can't help retrieve the disc and stuff because of my ankle...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it would be nice to have a few extra hands available...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, let's all do our best.
